459 struct sChannelPreference {
460 sChannelPreference(uint8_t oper_class,
461 wfa_map::cPreferenceOperatingClasses::ePreference preference,
462 wfa_map::cPreferenceOperatingClasses::eReasonCode reason_code)
463 : operating_class(oper_class)
464 {
465 flags.reason_code = reason_code;
466 flags.preference = preference;
467 }
468 sChannelPreference(uint8_t _operating_class,
469 wfa_map::cPreferenceOperatingClasses::sFlags _flags)
470 : operating_class(_operating_class), flags(_flags)
471 {
472 }
473
474 uint8_t operating_class;
475 wfa_map::cPreferenceOperatingClasses::sFlags flags;
476
477 bool operator==(const sChannelPreference &rhs) const
478 {
479 return operating_class == rhs.operating_class &&
480 flags.preference == rhs.flags.preference &&
481 flags.reason_code == rhs.flags.reason_code;
482 }
483
484 bool operator<(const sChannelPreference &rhs) const
485 {
486 if (operating_class != rhs.operating_class) {
487 return operating_class < rhs.operating_class;
488 }
489 if (flags.preference != rhs.flags.preference) {
490 return flags.preference < rhs.flags.preference;
491 }
492 if (flags.reason_code != rhs.flags.reason_code) {
493 return flags.reason_code < rhs.flags.reason_code;
494 }
495 return false;
496 }
497 };
